turns.input: Livia Marr gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Livia Marr pulls the leather boots from her satchel, turning them over to check the soles one last time. "Good stitching, solid leather. You'll want these broken in before any real walking," she says, and extends them toward Nicco.

She hands the pair of leather boots to Nicco, and he takes them.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Livia Marr blinks, the pins between her lips clicking softly as she shifts them aside. "Give them *back*?" She laughs, quick and bright, though her eyes narrow with something between amusement and assessment. "I made them to fit *you*, not me. You've got feet like a dockworker and I'm built like a sewing needle." She makes no move to take the boots, folding her arms loosely across her measuring tape. "Keep them. Consider it a welcome gift, or a thank-you for not keeling over on my stoop yesterday."

She glances toward Heartstone's heavy entrance, then back to Nicco with that same swift, evaluating look. "Unless you're offering because you can't pay your rent and need to trade for bread? In which case, talk to me straight and we'll figure something else out. I'm not in the habit of taking back finished work."
